# if let and while let for Partial Matching
When you only care about matching one pattern and ignoring all others, `if let` and `while let` avoid boilerplate:

```rust
fn main() {
    let config_val: Option<u32> = Some(8080);

    // if let syntax
    if let Some(port) = config_val {
        println!("Binding server to port {}", port);
    }

    // while let syntax
    let mut stack = vec![1, 2, 3];
    while let Some(top) = stack.pop() {
        println!("Popped: {}", top);
    }
}
```
